bug_fix_verification.original_bug: In Duo Mode, when a player creates a challenge and the second player joins via a friend code, the URL generates userId=undefined, breaking the PvP connection
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: 1) Backend matchmaking API did not return user_id in response, 2) FastAPI route /api/duo/{match_id} was declared BEFORE static routes like /api/duo/history, causing 'history' to be treated as a match_id
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: 1) Backend now returns user_id in matchmaking response (lines 926 and 960 in server.py), 2) Dynamic route moved after static routes (line 1452)
bug_fix_verification.verification_result: PASSED - API returns user_id correctly, route ordering is correct
